column2: [Root.GetTitledName] became ruler of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], a realm newly won in holy war. [From.GetTitledName] granted [Root.GetHerHim] a copy of the dynasty chronicles to carry to the new realm.

[Root.GetTitledName] became a [Root.GetLordLady] in [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], a realm newly won in holy war. [From.GetTitledName] granted [Root.GetHerHim] a copy of the dynasty chronicles to carry to the new lands.
[New.GetTitledFirstName] announced the formal annulment of [From.GetTitledFirstName]'s marriage with [Root.GetTitledName].
Several people in [Root.Capital.GetName] spoke of strange shapes dancing on the face of Morrslieb.
A woman ten feet tall was seen striding through the fields of [Root.GetName]. No one dared to stop her, and no one saw where she went.
A goat with three heads was born in [Root.GetName]. Some called it a curse of the Dark Gods, others a blessing.
Tens of thousands of crows descended on [Root.GetName] just before the harvest, doing great damage to the farmers' fields.
A star fell from the sky in [Root.GetName], killing three cows. The glowing green stone it left behind was gone by morning.
On Geheimnisnacht, Morrslieb rose full and green over [Root.Capital.GetName], and few in the city slept.
A warherd of beastmen came out of the forests of [Root.GetName] and burned a village before it was driven back into the trees.
A comet with two tails crossed the sky over [Root.GetName]. The priests argued for a month over what it foretold.
A ratcatcher in [Root.GetName] swore he had seen a rat as big as a man, walking on two legs. He was fined for drunkenness.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] forged the Empire of Man anew. For the first time in years the Elector Counts bowed to a single throne.
The Empire Reborn

Heralds ride out from Altdorf to every corner of the Old World. [From.GetTitledName] has united the provinces of the Empire under one crown, and the warhammer of Sigmar is raised once more over a single realm of Man.\n\nThe priests ring their bells. The Elector Counts swallow their pride. Somewhere in the Drakwald, the beasts grow restless.
A day for the histories.
Sigmar's Empire stands whole again!
Another man-king with a bigger hat. What is that to me?

They say no door in [Root.GetCapitalHoldingName] stays locked against you for long. Minstrels have started to sing about your conquests of the bedchamber, changing the names, though not by much. Husbands watch you at feasts. Wives watch you rather more closely.

Whispers, forged letters, a rumour dropped in the right ear at the right moment: you have ruined more reputations than most generals have ruined armies. Courtiers now weigh every word before they speak in your hearing, and nobody can recall the last time someone crossed you and kept their good name.

Seven challengers have faced you blade to blade, and seven have gone home bleeding, or not at all. Young bravos still talk of challenging you, but they talk of it quietly, and only after a great deal of drink.
Let them talk.
[GetDateText]: Tales of [Root.GetTitledName]'s seductions were told in every tavern of the realm.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] was known as a tongue that could ruin any name at court.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] won a seventh duel, and no one in the realm dared challenge [Root.GetHerHim] again.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] took back Vala-Azril, the lost hold of Azril-Ungol. The Dawi carved the name of the Reclaimer above the gate.
[GetDateText]: Vala-Azril was lost once more. The Dawi wrote it down, as they write everything down.
Vala-Azril Reclaimed

Word comes down the Underway and over the mountain passes: [From.GetTitledName] has taken back Vala-Azril. The lost hold is lost no longer. Its halls are being swept of goblin filth and rat droppings, its gates hung again, and the old runes above them recut by hands that remember how.\n\nIn every Dwarf hold the ale is broached. In every orc camp and every warren, someone is blamed.
The hold is ours again.
A toast to the Reclaimer!
Dey'll be back. We'll be back.
Dwarfs and their holes.
[GetDateText]: Malekith sat at last upon the Phoenix Throne of Ulthuan. Six thousand years late, and not one day too early.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] took the Phoenix Throne of Ulthuan for the Druchii. And somewhere in Naggarond, the Witch King seethed that it was not him.
The Phoenix Throne Falls

The ships out of Lothern carry black sails now. [From.GetTitledName] of the Druchii sits upon the Phoenix Throne, and the Shrine of Asuryan has been given to darker gods. The kin who were sundered six thousand years ago are one realm again, under the wrong master.
The Sundering is answered.
Ulthuan weeps. So do we.
Elves fighting elves. Let them.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] was hailed Sultan of all Araby. On the first of a thousand and one nights, the storytellers began the tale of [Root.GetFirstName].
[GetDateText]: On the thousand and first night, the tale was finished, and the Sultan let the storyteller live.
A Sultan of Sultans

From Al-Haikk to Lashiek, every emir and every sheikh bows to one master. [From.GetTitledName] rules all Araby, and in the coffee houses of every port the storytellers have begun a new tale. They say it will take a thousand and one nights to tell.
Let the storytellers begin.
The sands answer to one voice.
Spice will cost more now.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] raised the empire of Nehekhara from the sand. The Tomb Guard woke in their thousands and marched out of the necropolis to stand beside [Root.GetHerHim].
The Desert Wakes

The caravans that come out of the south tell all the same tale. The tombs are open, the old kings walk, and [From.GetTitledName] rules Nehekhara as it was ruled before Nagash. The Land of the Dead has a king again, and it remembers every border it ever had.
Nehekhara is eternal.
Man the walls. They remember us.
The dead should stay dead.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] took the throne of the Empire. What Vlad von Carstein could not do in all the Vampire Wars was done, and the Winds of Chaos blew a little colder.

[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] took the throne of the Empire, the Carstein Ring on [Root.GetHerHis] finger. What Vlad von Carstein could not do in all the Vampire Wars was done. Vlad would have been proud. Or jealous. With a von Carstein, it is the same thing.
An Emperor of the Night

[From.GetTitledName] sits upon the throne of Sigmar, and the Electors who would not kneel are not seen in daylight any more. The court keeps strange hours. The bells of Altdorf ring at dusk instead of dawn.
The night is ours.
The Emperor no longer attends the dawn services.
The Empire has a new master.

A tenth quest is won in the name of the Lady. Trolls, orcs, raiders and worse have fallen before your lance, and the troubadours of every court in Bretonnia have run out of rhymes for your name. They have settled on one word instead.
For the Lady!
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] won a tenth quest in the name of the Lady. The troubadours call [Root.GetHerHim] the Valiant.
[GetDateText]: The Green Knight was seen at the edge of the wood, and bowed to [Root.GetTitledName].
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] was crowned Everchosen by the Four. The Winds of Chaos howled, and the world held its breath.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] was crowned Everchosen by the Four. Once [Root.GetSheHe] prayed to Sigmar. Now Sigmar's children will pray to be spared.
The Everchosen

In the north the sky has turned the colour of a wound. The Four have crowned one champion above all others, and [From.GetTitledName] wears the crown. Every tribe of the Chaos Wastes is marching to the Everchosen's banner, and every seer in the south has the same dream.
The Four have chosen.
The end is coming.
All hail the Everchosen!
[GetDateText]: The clawpacks of [Root.GetTitledName] took [deed_city.GetName]. The Horned Rat had his due, and the Council of Thirteen pretended to be pleased.
The Ratmen Take a City

[deed_city.GetName] has fallen, and those who escaped tell the same story: the ground opened, the walls fell, and an army of rats as tall as men poured through the streets. [From.GetTitledName] rules there now, from somewhere underneath it.
Yes-yes! The Horned Rat has his due!
There is no such thing as Skaven. Probably beastmen. Or a plague.
Ratmen. Of course it was ratmen.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] took Marienburg, the richest port of the Old World, and the longships went home low in the water.
The Wolf at Marienburg's Door

The longships came up the Reik in the fog, and by morning Marienburg was burning. [From.GetTitledName] of Norsca has sacked the richest port in the Old World. The gold of a hundred merchant houses is on its way north, and the gods of the north are said to be well pleased.
Skal! To the gods and the gold!
The Marienburg merchant houses have written to their insurers.
The north is hungry this year.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] knelt before the Dragon Emperor and was received as an honoured guest, the first of the western peoples so honoured in living memory.
A Guest of the Dragon Emperor

Travellers on the road east bring strange news. [From.GetTitledName], a ruler of the western lands, has knelt in the Forbidden City and been received by the Dragon Emperor with the highest honours of Cathay. The road to the east has never been so open.
An honour beyond price.
The barbarian has learned some manners.
Silk and jade will flow west.

[GetDateText]: The hordes of Chaos broke on the walls of Kislev, Praag and Erengrad, and [Root.GetTitledName] held the Bulwark of the Old World. The house of [Root.GetFirstName] will be called the Wardens of the Bulwark.
The Bulwark Holds

The host of the north came down on Kislev and broke. [From.GetTitledName] held Kislev, Praag and Erengrad against it, and the survivors have fled back into the Wastes. The Winds of Chaos ebb a little, and the south owes the land of the Ice Queen one more debt it will never repay.
Kislev stands!
The Empire owes Kislev again.
Next time.
The north holds.

Fifty fights, an' you was in every one of 'em, right in da middle where da krumpin' is best. Da boyz is talkin'. Dey say you're da biggest an' da best, an' more of 'em turn up every day to see for demselves.
WAAAGH!

[GetDateText]: Fifty fights won by [Root.GetTitledName], an' every one of 'em in person. Da boyz say dat makes [Root.GetHerHim] da biggest an' da best, an' anyone who sez different can come say it to [Root.GetHerHis] face.
Thirty settlements have burned under the hooves of your warherd. The herdstones sing your name, and Gors come out of every forest of the Old World to follow the one who brings the ruin of Man.
Ruin to the cities of Man!
[GetDateText]: Thirty settlements burned under the hooves of [Root.GetTitledName]'s warherd. The herdstones sang, and the Winds of Chaos rose.

The pens are full to the last chain. The overseers report that there is no room for one more slave, and the priests of Hashut report that the Father of Darkness is pleased. The daemonsmiths have marked the occasion with a gift: a Hellcannon, fed and chained.
Hashut has his due.
[GetDateText]: The slave pens of [Root.GetTitledName] were full to the last chain. Hashut had his due, and the forges of Zharr-Naggrund roared.

Three elections won. The guilds say it was your speeches, the patricians say it was your gold, and the losers say a great many things that cannot be proven. A company of Tilean pike and crossbow has come to offer its services to a patron who clearly knows how business is done.
Everything has a price.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] won a third election. Everyone knew how. Nobody could prove it.

A fifth Black Ark has come to your shores and gone away again, with fewer Druchii aboard than it brought. Lothern has heard of it. The Sea Guard have sent a company to serve a lord who knows how to hold a coast.
Let them come again.
[GetDateText]: A fifth Black Ark was driven back into the sea by [Root.GetTitledName]. Lothern raised a banner in [Root.GetHerHis] honour.
[GetDateText]: [From.GetTitledName] won a holy war against the sultans of Araby. The Knights of the Blazing Sun rode out to serve the Spear of Myrmidia.
The Spear of Myrmidia

[From.GetTitledName] of Estalia has won a holy war against Araby, and the temples of Myrmidia ring their bells from Magritta to Bilbali. The Knights of the Blazing Sun, who have not forgotten the wars against the Sultan Jaffar, have ridden out to serve the victor.
For Myrmidia!
The sands remember.
Estalia has teeth after all.

The mountain roars and the heat is unbearable. The ring is in your hand, and it does not want to go. For a long moment you stand at the edge of the fire.

Then you open your hand.

When it is over, great eagles come down out of the smoke, and they carry you home.
It's gone. It's done.
[GetDateText]: One does not simply walk into the Doom March. A halfling did, and then went home to write a book about it.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] reached the Pools of Rejuvenation and drank. Explorers have sought them for centuries. Most of their bones are still on the trail.
The Fountain of Youth Is Found

A story is going round every port that trades with Lustria. [From.GetTitledName] went into the jungle after the Fountain of Youth, got past the Miyans, the thunder-lizards, the Lizardmen and the Coatl, and found it. They say [From.GetSheHe] drank, and came back younger.
Drink deep.
So it was real.

A third plaque of the Old Ones is home. The Skink scribes have set it back in the temple wall, in the place the Old Ones left for it, and they have gone quiet in the way they do when something is right. In the deep chambers, a Slann has not stirred. That is how you know it went well.
The Plan endures.

[GetDateText]: Every plaque brought home narrows the gap between the world as it is and the world as the Old Ones intended. Three were brought home by [Root.GetTitledName]. The gap is still very wide.

Fifty heretics exposed in the name of Sigmar. The Order keeps a list, and your name is at the top of it. So, it is said, is your name on a great many other lists, kept by people who would like very much to know where you sleep.
Sigmar's work is never done.
[GetDateText]: [Root.GetTitledName] exposed a fiftieth heretic in the name of Sigmar. Some of them were even guilty.
The Wild Hunt has taken its fifteenth holding of the lesser races. Kurnous rides at your shoulder, and the Wild Riders who follow the Horned God have come to ride with you.
The Hunt rides!
[GetDateText]: The Wild Hunt of [Root.GetTitledName] took a fifteenth holding of the lesser races. Kurnous rides at [Root.GetHerHis] shoulder.
The Huntmaster of Athel Loren

The horns of the Wild Hunt have been heard far outside Athel Loren this year, and fifteen towns of men and dwarfs have burned. [From.GetTitledName] leads the Hunt, and the woods are said to be closer to the farms than they were.
Dukes of the forest borders are reminded that the Lady's peace with the wood is a lease, not a deed.
Stay out of the woods.
The Wardens of the Bulwark

The Wardens of the Bulwark are descended from the ruler of Kislev who held Kislev, Praag and Erengrad against a host of Chaos and sent it broken back into the Wastes. Their forts are manned, their levies come when called, and every boyar of Kislev drinks to their name.
Cast It into the Fire
You have carried the ring all the way to the fires of Mount Doom. It would be so easy to keep it.
